name: @oursay/public-record
description: OurSay public verifiable record: event-sourced CRUD as append-only commitments (immudb) + private mutable store (Postgres), per-entity hash chain, fold-on-read state.

scripts.db:down: tsx ../scripts/destructive-guard.ts db:down && docker compose -p oursay-dev-public-record -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile worker down -v
scripts.db:test:down: tsx ../scripts/destructive-guard.ts db:test:down && docker compose -p oursay-test-public-record -f docker-compose.test.yml down -v
scripts.db:prod:down: tsx ../scripts/destructive-guard.ts db:prod:down && docker compose -p oursay-public-record -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile worker down -v
scripts.db:logs: docker compose -p oursay-dev-public-record -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile worker logs -f
